## portcheck monitor run

Keep checking monitors and warn when one goes down

### Synopsis

Check every monitor on its schedule until stopped (Ctrl-C). When a service
goes down (after --threshold failed checks in a row) or comes back up, print a
line and show a desktop notification. Changes to the monitors file are picked
up while running.

This runs only while this terminal (and the device) is on. For checks in the
background, use the tray app, or start this command at login.

```
portcheck monitor run [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help            help for run
      --no-notify       print alerts only; no desktop notifications
      --threshold int   failed checks in a row before a service counts as down (default 2)
```
